neighbours.label: an evaluative or reactive noun/participle that opens an argument slot for who values or reacts ('the value placed on', 'the natural response of', 'a preference for'), as opposed to concrete nouns in the same frame
fire: The survey reveals the importance placed on family by young voters.
Shivering is the normal response of muscles to a sudden chill.
Historians note the reaction of the clergy to the new law.
Teachers report a clear preference for printed books among pupils.
The ranking reflects the weight placed on research by each university.
Fever is a common response of the immune system to infection.
Economists studied the response of markets to the rate cut.
Diners showed a strong preference for the vegetarian menu.

The ranking lists the research budget of each university.

Economists met in the city after the rate cut.
Diners sat at the long table near the vegetarian buffet.
